headline: Deadlocked reaches 4,475 matched NTSC-U functions and 5,138 PAL functions
summary: Contributors gained matching C across game, network and engine code, alongside PAL-specific work. NTSC-U v1.00 now has 6.07% of code matched by size, or 350,776 of 5,782,424 bytes, and 4,475 of 18,085 functions; PAL SCES_532.85 separately reaches 5,138 of 18,113 functions. Matching means the C compiles to exactly the original game's bytes.
highlights: #50 and #51 bring separate batches of 157 and 167 functions; their pull-request totals share an earlier baseline and are not successive progress totals.
Assembler tooling now handles floating-point constants like the original assembler, enabling 27 PAL functions; another PAL routine covers Tempus Station (#49, #48).
PAL batches of 210 and 50 functions landed, followed by a missing-header fix and removal of duplicate PAL copies (#52, #53).
The proposed batch of 30 PAL functions in #54 remains unmerged.
